D8 — Class arrangement: keep the AuthCache facade, or have services use the existing adapter directly?
Project/branch/task: gstack-plan-count-wB30y0 on `main`, Scope Challenge structure gate for PLAN.md (TokenStore cut per D6, RequestPolicy kept per D7).
ELI10: After D6/D7 the plan has four new classes: AuthBroker, SessionMint, RequestPolicy and AuthCache. The plan describes AuthCache (PLAN.md:10-13) as a facade over the existing adapter that keeps every rule unchanged and adds no serialization: a pass-through. This question is structure only: same features either way. Whether the shared cache stays a module-level mutable export or becomes an injected dependency is Section 1's decision and stays pending in both options.
Stakes if we pick wrong: Keep a pass-through facade and you maintain a class that forwards calls forever; drop it and, if the adapter's API is wide or awkward for services, both services grow their own adapter-wrangling code.
Recommendation: B because the plan itself says the facade changes nothing; three classes over an already-tested adapter is enough engineering. If the adapter's API is genuinely hostile for services, say so and A becomes right.
Note: options differ in kind, not coverage — no completeness score.
Net: fewer moving parts now vs a seam you might want later (and can add later when a real need shows up).

options.label: B) Drop the facade: 3 classes over the adapter (recommended)
options.description: ✅ AuthBroker and SessionMint depend on the existing, tested adapter interface directly; ~8 files, 3 new classes. ✅ No pass-through layer to keep in sync when the adapter grows a method. ❌ If Section 1 later wants a narrow auth-only surface to serialize mutations behind, that seam must be introduced then. (human: ~0 / CC: ~0 to remove from plan)

options.label: A) Keep AuthCache facade: 4 classes
options.description: ✅ Gives services a narrow, auth-specific API instead of the whole adapter surface. ✅ Ready-made home if Section 1 decides mutations need coordinating in one place. ❌ As written it is a pure forwarder (PLAN.md:10-13): a class, tests and a file that add no behavior today. (human: ~1 day / CC: ~15 min)
